tagline.en: Kansas City to Manitoba along the river bottoms
tagline.zh: 自堪萨斯城沿河谷低地北上曼尼托巴

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.en: Interstate 35 and Interstate 70 in Kansas City, Missouri
start.zh: 密苏里州堪萨斯城，与 I-35、I-70 相接

end.en: The Canadian border at Pembina, North Dakota
end.zh: 北达科他州彭比纳，加拿大边境

en: I-29 is the westernmost north–south Interstate across the Great Plains. It leaves Kansas City, follows the Missouri River valley up past St Joseph, Council Bluffs and Sioux City, crosses into South Dakota on the Big Sioux, runs the length of the Dakotas' eastern edge through Sioux Falls, Fargo and Grand Forks, and ends at the Canadian border at Pembina, where Manitoba's Provincial Trunk Highway 75 carries the corridor on to Winnipeg.

Its cargo is agricultural. The road moves corn, soybeans and general merchandise out of a region where the nearest alternatives are far away, and roughly a fifth of the vehicles on the Iowa section are trucks — a smaller share than on I-80 or I-35 through the same state, but the volume that matters here is freight rather than commuters.

The northern half, through the Red River Valley, is as flat and straight as any Interstate in the country. The southern half is different in a way that matters: it was laid out along the broad bottomlands of the Missouri, on ground the river used to occupy and periodically reclaims.
zh: I-29 是横越大平原的南北向州际公路中最西的一条。它自堪萨斯城出发，沿密苏里河谷北上，经圣约瑟夫、康瑟尔布拉夫斯与苏城，在大苏河处进入南达科他，沿达科他两州东缘纵贯苏福尔斯、法戈与大福克斯，最终止于北达科他州彭比纳的加拿大边境；在那里，曼尼托巴的 75 号省级干线继续把这条走廊带往温尼伯。
它运载的是农产品。这条路把玉米、大豆与一般货物运出一个最近的替代通道都相距甚远的地区；艾奥瓦段的车辆中约五分之一是卡车——比同州的 I-80 或 I-35 占比更低，但这里真正要紧的量是货运，而非通勤。
北半段穿过红河谷，平直程度在全国州际公路中名列前茅。南半段则有一处关键差异：它铺设在密苏里河宽阔的河谷低地上——那是河流曾经占据、并时不时收回的土地。

en: Iowa began first. The earliest segments opened around Council Bluffs and Sioux City in late 1958, a 37-mile stretch from Missouri Valley to Onawa followed in December 1967, and the state finished on 31 August 1973 with a ten-mile piece in Fremont County reaching the Missouri line.

Missouri's work had started even earlier — soil work at the Pigeon Creek bridge site south of St Joseph by early 1957 — but the state did not finish until 28 July 1976, when an 18.7-mile section opened in Atchison County. North Dakota completed the Drayton to Pembina stretch in 1977, and in doing so became the first state to finish every mile of its Interstate system.

South Dakota was last. Its section opened in pieces from the late 1950s at Sioux Falls until 1982, when the stretch from Peever to New Effington was completed — the final segment of I-29 anywhere. At the southern end, the route once continued further into downtown Kansas City along two legs of the downtown loop; AASHTO approved reassigning those to I-35 in November 1976.
zh: 艾奥瓦起步最早。最初的路段于 1958 年底在康瑟尔布拉夫斯与苏城一带通车，1967 年 12 月又通车了密苏里瓦利至奥纳瓦的 37 英里；该州于 1973 年 8 月 31 日以弗里蒙特县约十英里、抵达密苏里州界的路段收尾。
密苏里的工程开始得更早——1957 年初已在圣约瑟夫以南的鸽溪桥址进行土方作业——但该州直到 1976 年 7 月 28 日才完工，当日阿奇森县 18.7 英里路段通车。北达科他于 1977 年建成德雷顿至彭比纳段，并因此成为第一个把本州州际公路系统全部建成的州。
南达科他最晚。其路段自 1950 年代末从苏福尔斯起分批通车，直到 1982 年皮弗至新埃芬顿段建成——那是 I-29 全线最后一段。在南端，这条路线曾沿市中心环路的两条边继续深入堪萨斯城市区；1976 年 11 月，美国州公路与运输工作者协会批准把那两段改划给 I-35。

en: The road's structural problem is the river it was built beside. In April 1962 a northbound section crossing the Big Sioux River collapsed during a flood; nobody was hurt, and later evaluation found that fast water had scoured sand and mud from around the bridge's foundations and undermined its supports.

The two modern failures were inundations rather than collapses. In 2011 the Missouri stayed above flood stage for 82 days and I-29 was shut from 9 June to 23 September; the last 34-mile stretch in Iowa, from the Missouri state line up to US 34, did not reopen until early October, and one section reopened with a crossover and two-way traffic to avoid a damaged bridge. In 2019 portions of the road closed four times, and one point north of Council Bluffs was shut for 102 days.

Iowa's response has been to raise the roadbed rather than to relocate it. The department of transportation has committed money specifically to flood resilience along this corridor, on the reasoning that the highway was put in the bottomlands in the first place because engineers of the 1950s believed the river had been brought under control by dams.
zh: 这条路的结构性问题就是它依傍的那条河。1962 年 4 月，一段跨越大苏河的北行路面在洪水中垮塌；无人受伤，事后评估认定湍急的水流冲刷掉了桥基周围的砂与淤泥，掏空了支撑。
两次现代的失效是被水淹没，而非结构垮塌。2011 年，密苏里河水位连续 82 天高于洪水位，I-29 自 6 月 9 日关闭至 9 月 23 日；艾奥瓦境内最后 34 英里——自密苏里州界至 US 34——直到 10 月初才重新开放，其中一段为绕过受损桥梁而采用中央开口、双向混行的方式通车。2019 年，这条路的部分路段四度关闭，康瑟尔布拉夫斯以北的一处关闭了 102 天。
艾奥瓦的应对是抬高路基，而非改线。该州交通部门专门为这条走廊的防洪韧性拨出了资金；其理由是：当初把公路修在河谷低地，正是因为 1950 年代的工程师相信水坝已经驯服了这条河。

timeline.en: Missouri begins soil work at the Pigeon Creek bridge site south of St Joseph.
timeline.zh: 密苏里在圣约瑟夫以南的鸽溪桥址开始土方作业。

timeline.en: The first segments open near Council Bluffs and Sioux City, and at Sioux Falls in South Dakota.
timeline.zh: 首批路段在康瑟尔布拉夫斯、苏城一带及南达科他州苏福尔斯通车。

timeline.en: A northbound section over the Big Sioux River collapses in an April flood.
timeline.zh: 4 月洪水中，一段跨大苏河的北行路面垮塌。

timeline.en: Iowa completes its section on 31 August.
timeline.zh: 艾奥瓦段于 8 月 31 日建成。

timeline.en: Missouri completes its section on 28 July; AASHTO reassigns the downtown Kansas City legs to I-35 in November.
timeline.zh: 密苏里段于 7 月 28 日建成；11 月，美国州公路与运输工作者协会将堪萨斯城市中心环路的路段改划给 I-35。

timeline.en: North Dakota finishes Drayton to Pembina, becoming the first state to complete its whole Interstate system.
timeline.zh: 北达科他建成德雷顿至彭比纳段，成为首个建成本州全部州际公路的州。

timeline.en: South Dakota completes the Peever to New Effington stretch, the last segment of the route.
timeline.zh: 南达科他建成皮弗至新埃芬顿段，即本路线最后一段。

timeline.en: The Missouri River stays above flood stage for 82 days and closes the road for more than three months.
timeline.zh: 密苏里河水位连续 82 天高于洪水位，道路关闭三个多月。

timeline.en: Flooding closes parts of the road four times; Iowa begins raising the roadbed.
timeline.zh: 洪水导致部分路段四度关闭；艾奥瓦开始抬高路基。
